d: HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking aims to be the international bank of choice for affluent customers, supporting their domestic and international banking, and holistic wealth management needs. We provide a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Global Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centers, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.

We are seeking a dynamic individual who can acquire quality funded Premier (balance based) customers for HSBC and cross sell relevant products to them at time of Premier onboarding. This requires the ability to build strong business relationships that will source these high value customers and to understand in detail the benefits of the Premier proposition.
q: Proven experience in acquiring and developing high-value client relationships, with a focus on quality New-to-Bank (NTB) customers and minimum investable or deposit balances of USD 120,000 or above.

Demonstrated ability to build and maintain effective relationships with referral sources, existing clients, professional networks and strategic partners to identify, engage and convert suitable prospects.

Strong knowledge of Premier Banking propositions, global service standards, wealth solutions, insurance, investments and credit products, with the ability to communicate their value clearly and confidently.

A track record of achieving acquisition, balance, cross-sell and profitability targets, with a clear focus on funded, sustainable relationships and long-term portfolio value rather than customer volumes alone.

Experience collaborating with Branch Management, Premier Service, Premier Wealth Management, Commercial Banking and Marketing teams to support effective customer handovers and maximize relationship value.
Excellent communication, interpersonal, influencing and negotiation skills, with the ability to establish trust and engage effectively with customers and stakeholders.

A full-time graduation degree of at least three years is essential for obtaining a UAE visa and work permit. For degrees obtained outside the UAE, valid attestations and equivalency are also mandatory.
r: Acquire funded (balance based) quality customer relationships for the bank and to successfully articulate the value and benefits of specific products which best meet these high-net-worth customers’ needs, including Wealth (Insurance & Investment) solutions, credit solutions, etc.
Maintain strong relationship with key stakeholders within the wider Premier & wealth teams to ensure there is a seamless transfer of the customer relationship once fully established.

Work in close partnership with Branch Management, Premier Service and Premier Wealth Management teams, Commercial Banking and Marketing to acquire quality relationships to meet the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) objectives and maximize profitability
Responsible for acquiring premier customers who are balanced based only (i.e. bring balance of USD 120k and above). Also, responsible for driving other needs/referrals and cross sales.
Support and contribute to building market position by locating, developing, defining and negotiating Wealth and Personal Banking product solutions for the employees of our existing clients.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
We believe diversity brings benefits for our customers, our business and our people. Different ideas and perspectives help us innovate, manage risk and grow the business in a sustainable way.
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
Issued by The Hong Kong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited.

d: Jumeirah, a global leader in luxury hospitality and a member of Dubai Holding, operates a portfolio of 29 exceptional properties across 11 countries in the Middle East, Europe, Asia, and Africa. In 1999, Jumeirah changed the face of luxury hospitality with the opening of the iconic Jumeirah Burj Al Arab and since then the brand has become known for its distinguished beachfront resorts, esteemed city hotels, and exclusive branded residences. Jumeirah is synonymous with Arabian luxury hospitality and the ability to craft distinctive, purposeful experiences for the world’s most discerning travellers.

Located on the pristine beaches of Bahrain’s West Coast, the resort features stunning ocean views, verdant greenery, and meandering waterways with modern, spacious rooms and suites as well as an exclusive Gulf Summer House, located directly on the beach. Guests can enjoy a variety of water sports activities, the resort’s five pools, and book treatments at Jumeirah’s signature Talise Spa.
